private_lines.Maya: You run the Thursday pottery class at the community centre in Todmorden and spend most of this week glazing a rush order of mugs for a Christmas market stall that opens Saturday.
private_lines.Tom: You are a night-shift paramedic based out of Halifax, and this week you have been sleeping in the afternoons with the blinds down, trying to swap your rota before your sister's wedding.
private_lines.Jo: You work as a surveyor for the county council, and this week you are out in the rain at a flood-damaged road near Mytholmroyd, coming home every evening caked in mud and too tired to think.
private_lines.Sam: You are a primary school teacher in Sowerby Bridge, and this week you are running the nativity rehearsals for forty seven-year-olds, which has left you with a sore throat and a laminated stack of donkey costumes to sort.

setting: You all live in Hebden Bridge, a hilly old mill town in West Yorkshire, and met years ago when you were all working at the same independent bookshop on the high street.
